description: This file defines a PHP class 'LangString' representing a language string data transfer object (DTO) used in the installer utility of the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as unitId, groupId, value, version, and note, along with corresponding constructor, getters, and a static factory method for creating an instance from an array.

classes.name: LangString
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating language string data for installer utility operations, supporting creation from array data.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID of the language string.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with the language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value/content of the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string associated with the language string, if any.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any note attached to the language string, if any.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LangString instance from an associative array.
